description: This file contains functions related to generating tree data structures for documents within a module of a CRM system, including retrieving nodes for categories, subcategories, and documents, as well as constructing hierarchical node structures.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node in a tree structure, used for categorization and document hierarchy.

methods.name: get_node_data
methods.description: Generates a JSON encoded list of document nodes based on parameters, used for tree navigation.

methods.name: get_category_nodes
methods.description: Retrieves category and subcategory nodes for documents, building the hierarchical structure.

methods.name: get_documents
methods.description: Fetches document nodes based on category and subcategory identifiers from the database.
